        apo-mak Feb 18, 2026

        Add support for importing OneTab exports.

        UI: new OneTabImportCard in ImportExport with an optional tag input and FilePickerButton.
        Hook: useBookmarkImport now accepts extraTags and passes them through.
        Importer: importBookmarksFromFile accepts extraTags and merges them into bookmark tags (deduplicated).
        Parser: add parseOneTabFile to parse OneTab lines (handles "URL | Title" or plain URL, skips non-URLs) and register the "onetab" source.

        Also add an i18n key for the OneTab import description.

        Greptile Summary

        Adds OneTab import support across the full stack: a new parseOneTabFile parser that handles "URL | Title" and plain URL formats, an extraTags parameter threaded from the UI through the hook into the importer (merged with deduplication), a new OneTabImportCard component with an optional tag input, and an i18n key for the description.

        • Parser correctly handles OneTab's line-based format, skipping non-URL lines and empty lines
        • The extraTags mechanism in importer.ts is generic and could be reused by other import sources in the future
        • No unit tests added for parseOneTabFile, unlike other parsers which have test coverage in parsers.test.ts
        • One hardcoded English string ("Tag (optional)") in the UI that bypasses i18n

        Confidence Score: 4/5

        • This PR is safe to merge — the changes are additive, follow existing patterns, and introduce no breaking changes.
        • The implementation is straightforward and follows the established patterns for other import sources. The parser logic is correct, the extraTags plumbing is clean, and the UI component matches the existing structure. Minor gaps are the missing i18n for one string and the lack of unit tests, but neither affects runtime correctness.
        • No files require special attention — packages/shared/import-export/parsers.ts could use test coverage for the new parser.

        Important Files Changed

        Filename Overview
        apps/web/components/settings/ImportExport.tsx Adds OneTabImportCard component with an optional tag input and file picker. The placeholder string "Tag (optional)" is hardcoded instead of using the i18n t() function, inconsistent with the rest of the component.

        apps/web/lib/i18n/locales/en/translation.json Adds new i18n key for OneTab import description. English fallback is configured, so other locales will gracefully degrade.
